en: A colored view over the historic town of Meissen, showing a hillside covered with trees and red‑roofed houses leading up to a large hilltop complex with a cathedral featuring twin Gothic towers and surrounding buildings. In the right foreground stands a separate church tower with a greenish dome roof. The sky is blue with a few clouds, and red German text is printed along the top.
